requirements.statement: The integration owner can regenerate a read-only, purely derived project delivery dashboard that aggregates task runtime state, delivery-plan requirement progress, roadmap milestones, and verification gate and risk posture from the tracked sources of truth without persisting or duplicating any authoritative state.
acceptance_criteria: A single harness command regenerates one self-contained static HTML dashboard from live sources: task records plus task-branch runtime state, backlog dependencies and owned paths, delivery plans, the roadmap, and the manifest gate registry.
Every task runtime state in the dashboard equals the state reported by agent.sh list for the same commit, including active states resolved from task branches rather than only durable records.

Every requirement-level state in the dashboard equals the state reported by delivery_plan.py status, including accepted, acceptance-ready, in-progress, partially-delivered, planned, claimable, and dependency-blocked.
The dashboard is generated output and is never committed; a git-ignored build artifact path is used and the generator is deterministic for a fixed repository state.
All task titles and free-form text are HTML-escaped so untrusted backlog content cannot inject markup.

Negative: the generator must NOT maintain, cache, or hand-edit its own copy of task, requirement, or milestone status; any state that is not derived from the tracked sources of truth fails acceptance.
Negative: resolving active task states (claimed, in_progress, review, blocked) from only .agents/records/*.json without merging task-branch records fails acceptance because it omits in-flight work.
Negative: committing the generated HTML into the repository, or emitting a dashboard whose task or requirement states disagree with agent.sh list or delivery_plan.py status, fails acceptance.
A trusted dashboard_test gate asserts, on fixtures, that the aggregation agrees with agent.sh list and delivery_plan.py status, and it runs within governance-test and the repository verify gate.
